claims.claim: Vylor’s Seed Business develops and sells commercial seed that combines advanced germplasm and trait technologies to maximize farmer yield potential.
claims.quote: The Seed Business is a global leader in developing and supplying commercial seed combining advanced germplasm and traits that offer maximum yield potential for farmers around the world.

claims.claim: Management states that Vylor is a leader in multiple key seed markets worldwide, including North America corn and soybeans and Europe corn and sunflower.
claims.quote: The Company is a leader in many key seed markets, including North America corn and soybeans, Europe corn and sunflower, as well as Brazil, India, South Africa and Argentina corn.

claims.claim: Pro forma net sales grew 4 % year‑over‑year in the first nine months of 2026, driven by price/mix improvements and licensing revenue.
claims.quote: Pro forma net sales1 increased 4% versus prior year.

claims.claim: On October 1 2026 the Seed Business was spun off as Vylor through a tax‑free, pro rata dividend‑in‑kind transaction.
claims.quote: On October 1, 2026, Corteva, Inc. (“Corteva” or “the company”) completed its previously announced separation into two independent, publicly traded companies … through a pro rata dividend in‑kind of all of the then‑issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Vylor to holders of Corteva’s common stock as of the close of business on September 24, 2026 (the “Vylor Separation”).

claims.claim: The Board authorized a $3 billion multi‑year share‑repurchase program to return capital to shareholders.
claims.quote: The Board also authorized a new $3 billion multi-year share repurchase program.

claims.claim: A cash dividend of $0.13 per share was declared for 2026, reflecting a commitment to ongoing shareholder returns.
claims.quote: On October 22, 2026, the Company announced that its Board of Directors authorized a common stock dividend of $0.13 per share, payable December 7, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 30, 2026.

claims.claim: Management highlights a $19 billion technology pipeline anchored by 12 platform launches, including the industry’s first gene‑edited multi‑disease‑resistant corn platform.
claims.quote: The Company is home to a $19 billion technology pipeline, anchored by 12 groundbreaking technology platform launches … the industry’s first gene‑edited multi‑disease resistant corn platform, designed to provide built‑in protection against multiple major diseases.

claims.claim: Judgment: Accelerate commercialization of the gene‑edited multi‑disease‑resistant corn platform to capture early‑adopter market share, as management signals this as a differentiating pipeline asset.
claims.quote: the industry’s first gene‑edited multi‑disease resistant corn platform, designed to provide built‑in protection against multiple major diseases
